content: Gwiyavǝtgwiig nǝ ndzǝgana Yesu
Tǝhala hǝngah ǝngkwaha kaa langtǝrdǝtlang nǝ Yesu kǝ Bitrus, ard Yakubu, ard zǝrababba Yakub, kwa iin nǝ Yuhwan, dagat damma ghǝra aghwa ba kyakw ba daghuvaatǝra.
Kaa gwivǝtgwiig nǝ ndzǝganan tǝvuukwatǝra, baz huɗǝvǝgaan ndakwi mbiig band faciya, sǝdavaan ndakwi kaa nǝg kǝ maɗǝkw ba tǝlla.
Batwatsǝra kaa tsǝgwatsugw kǝ tlayang Musa ard tlayang Iliya. Kaa taa ghai kǝ iitǝr dǝ Yesu.
Aiyam Bitrus taa kǝ Yesu, “Yaazhigǝla, marawa nǝ ndzǝgana miyam vaakwana. Akwama haighanthaiga ǝn tafǝgan kǝ tsakwamah hǝkǝrɗa, pal kǝskǝgha, pal kǝ Musa, pal kiyava Iliya.”

Ma sartǝn ba ndzǝgaan taa ghai nǝ Bitrusa, kaa hǝɗtǝrduhǝɗǝg nǝ akummba, kaa cinngvacinng nǝ ghai sagal ma akumb taakiya, “Kwana iin zǝrara, kwan waig naiya, ǝn cinngaan kǝ ǝmtakǝraan ba vaivaiya. Cinngamarnucinnga.”
Cinngara ba nǝ mbǝrzahaan ǝndkwaha, kaa gǝdzǝgǝtgǝdzǝg kǝ iitǝr ba vaivaiya, baz mbǝɗa damma haay kǝ iitǝra.
Kaa sagau kǝ Yesu taptǝrnana amaa, “Ciyamciiga, gǝdzam biya.”
Kaparant ba nǝ iitǝr kǝ ghǝra, nǝghara bi aanji ndǝwar biya, nǝghara ba Yesu daghuvaana.
Ar tǝghǝrdǝga saay nǝ iitǝr ma aghwa, am nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Tagamarbi aanji kǝ war kǝ dǝgiti amaa nǝghǝga nǝ uuram biya, bamma ciyavantciig Zǝra Uud ma gǝtlah dǝ shifǝga.”
Kaa ndavgarundavǝg nǝ mbǝrzahaan taakiya, “Aujibǝg kǝ lii tsaga adzahadzaha Muus ar taakiya, barari bamma tlayang Iliya wada saay ba zǝnngwi?”
Kaa ngutǝrangug kǝ Yesu taakiya, “Ba pakatta da saay nǝ Iliya, da ɓadlǝna kǝ dǝgitah ba ɗǝmma.
Ən tagkurtag ciya, sahi ba wur nǝ iliya, nǝgharaaka bi kǝ iin biya, baz ɓagar dǝgitahi naaghant nǝ ghǝraatǝra. Bandkwah dlaɓa Zǝra Uud da hǝɓgaan kǝ dlaɗ mizha dǝvaatǝra.”
Ngal nǝghǝgaakanǝghǝg kǝ mbǝrzahaan taakiya, tagtǝr tǝghǝr kǝ Yuhwan dadda tsuufǝga.
Mbǝghanambǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ zǝr kwad shiɗkwa shatanaha
Daral ba nǝ iitǝr da vaka dzahava dlamaa kǝlaawa, kaa sagau kǝ uuda nǝ iin da vak Yesu kǝla kǝ iin kǝ ghunnj tǝvuukwana,
amaa, “Yaazhigǝla, zhuwardaalazhuug yagh kǝ zǝrara, tsagwara nǝ shiɗkwa shatanaha, hǝɓgaan dlaɓ kǝ dlaɗ ba vaivaiya. Shiga ngwɛn wan ba ɓalgaan damma kaara ard yuwa.
Langandalang davak mbǝrzahagha, pǝletǝrvaapileg nǝ mbǝgaana.”

Kaa ngugarangug nǝ Yesu amaa, “Kuram uudaha zamanna, am maay dǝ fadghǝr biya, am ɓa kǝlaadǝra, ǝn da zǝlma ǝmkyangar nai dǝ kurami? Ən da zǝlma ǝmkyangar nai ɓǝshkur kwanahaani? Ayakam kǝ zǝriin sa vaakwana.”
Kaa cagaraacag nǝ Yesu kǝ gyi kǝ shiɗkwa Shatanhna, kaa ɗugarsɗuug kǝ shiɗkwa shatanah kǝ zǝriina, batwatsǝra ngal mbǝg kǝ iina.
Kaa sagau kǝ mbǝrzah sa vak Yesu ma sartǝn maay aanji ndǝwar vakaan biya, am nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, “Aujilbǝg kǝskǝmnd pǝlekǝmndvaa lagwa shiɗkwa Shatanahiini?”

Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Kwakyarvad hǝtsalhǝtsǝg nǝ fadghǝraruwa, ǝn tagkurtag kǝ jiira, akwamaa mǝng nǝ fadghǝraru ba hǝɗikǝn band zǝra mastada, mammaa tagardatag kǝ aghwǝn taakiya, ‘Ciig vaakwana, dǝg da vaakwaha,’ maa ciiga. Maa maay nǝ dǝgiti pilkurvaapilǝg biya.
Lagwguvda bi nǝ hulfa kwanahaan biya, bamma tǝdvad dzǝgwazhigǝla ard kǝsa andǝla.”
Gwiya tagatag nǝ Yesu kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ ǝmtsǝgaana
Dzaharvǝt ba nǝ mbǝrzahǝn ma Galili, kaa tagtǝrtag nǝ Yesu taakiya, “Da vǝlav Zǝra Uud damma dǝv kǝ uudaha,
ar da tsǝgaana. Tǝ hǝnga hǝkǝrɗ ta ciivant dǝ shifǝga.” Kaa tsǝtǝratsǝg kǝ vǝgh ba vaivai kǝ mbǝrzahaana.
Ɗiya hadama vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla

Daragha ba nǝ Yesu ard mbǝrzahaan damma Kafarnahum, kaa tlǝgaraatlǝg nǝ lii cauwa hadam kwakyarvad vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl kǝ Bitrusa, am nǝ iitǝr taa kǝ iina, “Maay nǝ dadda kwa tsagkur dǝgit ɗiya hadam kwakyarvad vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl biya?”

Aiyam nǝ Bitrusa, “Ɗigaana.” Dagha ba nǝ Bitrus da hǝnyaha, kaa fǝgarzhafǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ tagar ghaiy taakiya, “Au wagha nǝghǝga nǝng tǝghǝr kǝ ndavǝgni? Ar caug vak war nǝ tlǝksaha duni kǝ hadam, ar caug vak zarhaatǝr nii, ar caug vak uudahi tlǝrǝn hi?”
Ngwa ba nǝ Bitrus taakiya, “Vak uudahi tlǝrna.” Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Mbats maay nǝ zarhaatǝr ɗigaan biya.

Bakǝvakwaha, haik badza ǝrviɗmahuɗ kǝ iitǝr dǝ kǝmya, dǝg damma yuwa haiya ɓǝlǝg kǝ kwanjara, agha wurant kǝ ghaiya kilfi agha fǝgarzha nǝng kǝ vigaana, agha da tlǝknatlǝg kǝ kwaɓi da tlǝgaltlǝg kǝ pǝlgaana, agha kǝsant kǝ kwaɓiina, agha ɗiya kǝ hadamagh ard dǝgara.”

footnotes.text: Kyalma vindǝgahi ndza wura ar maay dǝ kwanǝn kǝ aay biya.
